name: Androbeet
tagline: Essays and original words for realities that never had names.

about_sections.heading: Who I am
about_sections.body: Androbeet (Andrew) is a self-taught writer, philosopher, and content creator. His work is about naming the unnamed — the gaps in our emotional and political vocabulary that leave people without language for their own experience.

about_sections.heading: What I write about
about_sections.body: Philosophy, atheism, feminism, and the psychology of belief — why people inherit the ideas they inherit, and what it costs them to keep them.

about_sections.heading: The Lexicon
about_sections.body: A running project of original terms — words coined for realities that never had one. If you use a term from here, credit the source.
